snippet.title: Haunted Cleaner- Gameplay Our Upcoming Tidy-Up Cozy Game ✨
snippet.description:
A spooky house, a messy ghost, and a whole lot of satisfying cleaning. ✨

Get a first look at Haunted Cleaner, the upcoming cozy light puzzle organization game where every item has a story! (and a place!)

If you loved the relaxing vibes of Unpacking or the satisfaction of A Little to the Left, you’ll feel right at home with Haunted Cleaner.

If you enjoy relaxing aesthetics, tidy up mechanics, and heart warming stories, this is your next favourite game!

👻WANT TO PLAY EARLY?💌
We’re looking for beta testers! Sign up for our newsletter to secure your spot and follow the development: 
👉 https://www.headkino.com

✨Wishlist our game✨
